entries.clue: Close embrace and a stalking walk, out of Buenos Aires; the rose is film myth
Bladed block skimmed along a board to curl off fine shavings
Complete whirl on one leg, the head snapping round to fix on a spot
Bag slung beside a rear rack for carrying the shopping home
Ballet leap from one foot to the other, the big one a full mid-air split
Ballroom drama in which he plays the matador and she the swirling cape
Inflatable rubber sleeve hidden beneath the tread
Stout metal rod, tightened by a nut, that holds a frame together
Studs under a shoe that click you firmly into the pedals
Small toothed wheel, or a lowly worker in a vast machine
Kneaded soft in the hand, then pressed round a pane to bed the glass in
